subject: Bluebikes Expansion and Wellington Redesign Planning
overview: The Commission voted to support a grant application for additional Bluebikes stations and reviewed major regional infrastructure projects, including the Wellington Circle redesign and the Somerville Bike Network Plan. Members also received updates on local street projects and the distribution of bike safety equipment.

items.title: Call to Order and Minutes
items.summary: The Commission approved the minutes from the previous meeting and conducted a roll call.

items.title: Pothole and Safety Reporting
items.summary: The Chair advised members and the public to report urgent road hazards directly to city staff in addition to using the See-Click-Fix platform to ensure safety issues are flagged for cyclists.

items.title: Bluebikes Grant Support
items.summary: The Commission approved a motion to write a letter of support for a grant application seeking funding for four additional bike-share stations.

items.title: Wellington Circle Redesign
items.summary: Members discussed the state's redesign process for Wellington Circle and coordinated attendance for an upcoming working group meeting to advocate for improved cyclist safety.

items.title: Community Events and Future Rides
items.summary: Members shared information on upcoming regional bike tours and discussed ideas for future Medford-based community rides to highlight local connectivity.

items.title: Bike Light and Helmet Distribution
items.summary: Ernie Meunier reported on the distribution of 160 bike light kits and discussed coordinating with the police department to distribute youth helmets using grant funds.

items.title: Wellington Underpass Public Meeting
items.summary: The Commission highlighted an upcoming public hearing regarding a shared-use path connection project at the Route 28 Wellington underpass.

items.title: Somerville Bike Network Plan
items.summary: The group reviewed Somerville's draft bike plan to identify potential cross-border connections and infrastructure priorities on shared corridors like Main Street and North Street.

items.title: Infrastructure and Roadway Updates
items.summary: City staff provided updates on Winthrop Street striping and speed tables, George Street resurfacing, and ongoing research into right-of-way signage at side-street intersections.

items.title: Medford Square Planning and Bike Racks
items.summary: The Commission discussed participation in Medford Square focus groups and announced a grant request for new bike racks and potential parking meter-mounted locking rings.
